title: Tim and the Pip
lines: A pip is at the mat.
Sis! Tip the pip at the pit!
The pip fit! It fit at the pit.
Pat it, Tim. Pat, pat, pat.
Tim and Sis sat at the pit.

questions.ask: Where did Sis tip the pip?
questions.listenFor: Into the pit, the little hole Tim sat by. Line three says it. Point at that line and let your child read it again.

questions.ask: Did the pip fit in the pit?
questions.listenFor: Yes. Line four says it twice. If your child is unsure, ask them to find the word fit.

questions.ask: What do you think will come up out of that pit? Tell me why you think so.
questions.listenFor: A pip is a seed, so a plant or a tree is a lovely answer, but so is anything with a reason behind it. Listen for the why, not the what.
